profile.headline: Perception Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer for Harris Corporation specializing in point cloud processing and data management for subsea applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead: 
Oversee project schedule, budget, and tasking for  sensor fusion, localization, and object segmentation/identification software for an autonomous underwater vehicle.  Leverage Agile workflow to quickly adapt to new challenges and opportunities, and coordinate between development and field integration teams.

Act as an intermediary between program management and the technical team, including balancing daily tasking with program goals. Generate media and communicate technical information meaningfully to program management and customers.

Oversee development of perception software on edge devices. Migrated GPU and memory intensive software to perform on low SWAP payloads.

Restructured software architecture to align with industry standards, including implementing Data Distribution Service (DDS) communications. 

Perception Systems R&D Principal Investigator: Oversaw the development of AI/ML object segmentation and identification capabilities for 3D point cloud data and AI/ML model deployment on edge devices.
positions.insights: Technical Project Leadership, Embedded C++ and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Collaborated in re-architecting proof of concept C++  software into a minimum viable product with a modular and expandable design. Demonstrated on a vehicle with integrated sensors at sea.

Optimized CUDA sensor fusion algorithms for real time high resolution world model building. Developed a method for compressing, updating, and storing large point cloud color and metadata into world models for fast updates.

Designed a generic, reusable visualization framework in Qty/OpenGL which has been adapted for use on several programs.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Developed orbit visualizations and interactive scenarios for a Space Command and Control project in Java, Java FX, and OpenGL. Maintain and expand the command system for user control and generate automated demonstration scenarios.

Researched and prototyped methods of extracting 3D data from single camera datasets in MATLAB leveraging computer vision principles such as optical flow.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Modeled volume, heat, and freshwater transport of Pacific water through Barrow Canyon and along the Chukchi-Beaufort Shelfbreak in the Arctic using MATLAB and data obtained from a Slocum Glider

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Processed electron data from four Cluster II satellites orbiting through the Earth’s magnetotail using IDL and created 2-D images of magnetic reconnection sites. Applied these images to a 3-D model of magnetic reconnection.
